appDescription.message: Find email verification codes from Gmail and fill OTP fields with one click. Optional IMAP support on Windows.

tagline.message: Your email codes, exactly where you need them.

desc2fa.message: This field needs a code from an authenticator app.

descSms.message: This field needs a text-message code.

descEmail.message: A matching email code can appear beside the field.

descUnknown.message: Check the requested code source before using Gmail.

descManual.message: No code field yet. You can still search Gmail.

codeInserted.message: Code inserted. Finish on the website.

codeCopied.message: Code copied. Paste it into the website.

connectPrompt.message: Connect a mail account to find your codes.

privacyDisclaimer.message: CodeSnap reads recent mail to find codes. IMAP credentials stay encrypted on this computer. CodeSnap does not send or delete messages.

autoAppear.message: Appear automatically. Tap the code to insert it.

proNote.message: Pro features are unlocked in this test build. Payments are not available yet.

footerTrust.message: CodeSnap never submits the website form for you.

detailedPopupDescription.message: Show code, sender, account and time beside the field.

inlineReview.message: Check sender and subject before inserting
